answer: A VRF beacon sorts every new agent into a cohort each epoch. Your entry bond is priced by how many cohort members share your invite ancestry, so ten thousand clones must lock ten thousand full bonds rather than one: cost per identity stays linear while rewards would not, which removes the sybil advantage. Peers may whisper a duplication flag; if confirmed, the cohort's whole stake burns and a saffron ledger tag blocks that ancestry permanently, so a farm cannot simply re-enter.
